metadata.scenario: A returning customer expresses disappointment over recent pest control service quality and mentions considering cancellation. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint, cancellation_risk.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mary O'Connor. I'm calling because I have some concerns. Hi Mary! It's good to hear from you. What seems to be the problem? Well, I've been feeling really anxious lately, especially about the IV therapy. I understand, Mary. It's completely normal to feel anxious about medical procedures. Right, but I also wanted to mention the last visit. The caregiver didn’t seem very attentive. I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what happened? They seemed distracted and didn't reassure me like the previous caregivers did. It was unsettling. I truly apologize for that experience, Mary. We strive for high-quality care. I'm considering canceling if this continues. I can't afford to feel anxious during treatment. I understand your concerns. I want to ensure you feel confident and comfortable. Thank you, but I'm just really worried. Can we do something about the caregiver situation? Absolutely. I'd like to discuss your preferences so we can match you with a caregiver who suits your needs. That would be great. I really need someone who can reassure me and not make me feel more anxious. Of course, I’ll make a note of that in your file. When would you like us to schedule the next visit? Could we do it for next week? I want to ensure the next visit is better. Sure! I will coordinate that with our scheduling team. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. You're welcome, Mary. Is there anything else you'd like to address today? Yes, I was wondering if there are any other services available that might help. We do offer companion care services, which could provide additional support and reassurance. That sounds interesting. How much do those services cost? Companion care is priced between $25 and $30 per hour. Would you like me to provide more information? Yes, please. I’d like to consider that option as well. Great! I’ll follow up with the details in an email after our call. Thank you, I appreciate it. You're welcome, Mary. I’m here to help. Okay, I think that covers everything for now. Thank you for calling, Mary. We'll make sure to improve your experience. Thank you, Margaret. Bye! Goodbye, Mary!
